title.zh: Stablecoin issuers have replaced 40% of China’s lost US Treasury demand
title.en: Stablecoin issuers have replaced 40% of China’s lost US Treasury demand

current_state.zh: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco researchers find that stablecoin issuers have added about $200 billion in US Treasuries and repos over five years, offsetting more than 40% of China's decline in Treasury holdings and potentially reaching $400 billion by 2030.
current_state.en: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco researchers find that stablecoin issuers have added about $200 billion in US Treasuries and repos over five years, offsetting more than 40% of China's decline in Treasury holdings and potentially reaching $400 billion by 2030.
